job.question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS) investment consulting services RFP?
job.acceptance: Accept Central Time/CT; explicit equivalent timezone conversion acceptable.

reviews.reason: The document is an August 2021 RFP issued by the Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS), not the Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System (OPERS). Its proposal deadline is different, so it does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: Requests for Proposal Issued August 2021 Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS)
Those who wish to be considered must submit their completed proposal, via email to the Point of Contact, by 5:00 p.m., PT, October 1, 2021.
